verdict.rationale: Consensus documents a REST API and an MCP server that expose the same retrieval and synthesis surface as the web app, and it markets the API for running automated searches inside custom workflows and agent pipelines. That amounts to first-party headless, programmatic operation, and its documented parameters (e.g. excludePreprints) confirm the surface is scriptable. Missing for 10: a CLI or CI-specific integration guidance (auth tokens, rate limits, pipeline examples), and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless automation.
